errors.text: The proposed machine-learning model is a generic composition-to-property predictor, whereas the target intervention is specifically a machine-learning interatomic potential coupled to free-energy perturbation in a DFT-based melting workflow.
It omits the replacement of thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation, which is the principal source of the target computational efficiency gain.
No prior evidence is cited or described despite the explicit request for supporting evidence.
The claimed validity limit of up to 10 principal elements is arbitrary and unsupported.
No quantitative accuracy, speedup, or free-energy agreement target is provided.
